THE HUMAN BEHIND THE COMMITS

Hi, I’m Nino.
I like making
things happen.

I’m a developer from Slovenia who’s happiest turning an idea into something people can interact with. Mobile apps, web products, games — I follow the problem, then find the right tools.

I’ve built GameOn from scratch, taken Klubis to a real club, and led teams on GameOn’s React Native version and Planify. I enjoy owning the details and helping everyone see the bigger picture.
